recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of two women in 1980s high-fashion attire, set against a draped, textured grey fabric backdrop. The composition features a high-contrast mix of ornate, illustrative script in the upper left and sharp, modern italics on the right, framing the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects centered with a slight diagonal offset for depth
Ornate script balancing the visual weight of the subjects' heads
High-contrast black and gold clothing against a neutral grey background
Sharp horizontal text cutting across the mid-right vertical space
coreInvariants: Draped grey fabric background with visible folds
High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows
Combination of elaborate flourishes and clean geometric type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-length figures occupying the central 60% of the frame, standing on a floor covered by the same backdrop fabric.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ornate logo-like script in the top left corner acts as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left script, down through the subjects' faces, to the horizontal text on the right, and finally to the floor texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant breathing room around the subjects, particularly at the top and sides, emphasizing the studio setting.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and cream (clothing patterns and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background allows the high-value gold patterns and skin tones to pop.

letterConstructionRules: Top-left: Extreme flourishes, circular swashes, and thin-to-thick stroke transitions
Right-side: Uniform stroke weight, sharp 15-degree italic slant, all-caps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capitals in the script feature concentric circular flourishes
Right-side text uses a specific color-block highlight on individual letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between Victorian-era calligraphic flourishes and late-20th-century modernist italics.

avoid: Serif fonts for the right-side text
Modern minimalist scripts for the top-left

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary formal flourishes and stroke contrast for the logo area.
Matches the clean, slanted, geometric feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of two women in 80s fashion (one in a gold-patterned black dress, one in a cream blouse and black trousers) standing on a draped grey fabric floor against a matching draped grey fabric wall. Soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ornate white calligraphic script with heavy circular flourishes in the top-left. Add a single line of small, white, all-caps condensed italic sans-serif text in the middle-right, with one specific letter highlighted in red.

verificationChecks: Is the script in the top-left sufficiently ornate with circular swashes?
Is the background a single continuous draped fabric?
Does the right-side text have a sharp italic slant?
Is the color palette restricted to grey, black, gold, and white?

adjustableVariables: Specific letter chosen for the red accent
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script flourishes do not obscure the subjects' faces
Verify the italic text is perfectly horizontal despite the slant
Confirm the fabric texture is visible in both floor and wall
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Draped fabric backdrop + (Ornate Script [Top-Left] + Condensed Italic [Mid-Right])
